answer: Proposal: one credential per person. Rotating issuers verify live presence at enrollment and publish each capture's hash to an append-only registry — durable as cedar, since it must outlast every issuer — that rejects a template resurfacing, like karst water, under a new key. Assume issuers verify presence honestly and dedup matching holds; k clones then cost k ceremonies (linear, serial per body), so cap each credential's lifetime reward at its enrollment fee over the same horizon: k fees paid, ≤ k fees earned. Leaks: issuer collusion, twins, perturbed captures.
